 · Member of Parliament

 Sponsor of the ​trip 
 The Canadian-Muslim Vote 
 Purpose 
 To provide an opportunity for Members of Parliament and civil organizations to witness the dire situation Palestinians are living through in Jordan and the West Bank. This trip served as a chance for Members of Parliament to go on a first-hand fact finding mission to develop strategies in ensuring the lives of Palestinians are preserved and human rights are upheld for all across the middle east.
